releaseNotes: Flow Client v1.5.1: Fixed Quick Connect Add Server form clipping; adjusted dropdown position near window edge; added smooth open/close entrance/exit slide & fade animations; added interactive hover scale/color feedback to server Play and Delete buttons; fixed Modrinth version ComboBox display name formatting and instance version badge; enforced Vanilla instance rules (no mods/shaders tabs or folders created, Modrinth filtered to Textures only); and restored fluid sliding animation on ModernToggleSwitch ball.
